title: Nutty Silky Peruvian Pork Knuckle Stew
description: A nostalgic Peruvian dish featuring pork knuckle in a rich and flavorful stew, flambeed to perfection with a nutty and silky texture, halal-friendly.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the aji amarillo peppers and cook for 1 minute.
Add the pork knuckle and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the pumpkin seeds and cook for 1 minute.
Add the peruvian corn beer and chicken broth, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2 hours.
Flambe the stew with a kitchen torch, if desired.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with toasted pumpkin seeds and chopped fresh cilantro.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
